spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the exact SVG 2 surface — side="left|right" on textPath over a closed circular path, the case the attribute was added for — and probes it the only honest way, by measuring rendered glyph geometry (side has no IDL reflection).

interactive.rationale: A radio toggle sets the real attribute on the live badge, the markup snippet tracks it, and the measurement table plus aria-live readback update from getStartPositionOfChar/getExtentOfChar.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index promises the canonical inside/outside toggle with rendering-based measurement; the page is exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the unsupported tier and explains the reversal semantics, but leaves startOffset/anchor interplay and open paths to the sibling side-lab (cross-linked).

references.rationale: chromestatus.com/feature/5422782593761280, the SVG 2 section and MDN are linked.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's closed-path assertion uses the same rendering probe as this page; default-left and invalid-value assertions pin the value-space, and the animatable contract is honestly manual.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: probe honestly reported delta 0.0px (unsupported), the amber banner rendered, the measurement table read real positions (55.6,138.1; ~95px ring), autorun selected side=right and the readback stated the attribute is set but inert; console clean; mobile emulation overflow-free. The true flip needs Chrome 156/Firefox and is recorded as an open question. An initial baseline-position measure was found misleading during review and replaced with glyph-box-centre measurement.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the probe outcome, the explicit fallback branch with the measured delta, and each measured render with side/distance/where details.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; SVG strokes/fills use var(--text-black)/var(--accent-*) tokens; radios in fieldset/legend rows at 44px.

accessibility.rationale: The SVG is role=img with a title, the toggle is native radios with visible focus, the readback is aria-live, and the measured table mirrors the visual state textually.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360x740 DPR3: zero horizontal overflow, badge scales via viewBox with min() width, no console errors.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Graphics need text alternatives and visual state needs a non-visual equivalent.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: role=img + <title> on the badge, decorative core text left in the image, and the measured aria-live readback narrates which side the caption is on.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible inline SVG text labels along a path with alternative text
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: No path-text-specific guidance exists in the corpus (nearest matches were mask/clip visual-design guides), so general SVG accessibility rules apply.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Recorded as the justified exception: applied the general accessibility guide's img-role + title + text-equivalent pattern instead.

openQuestions.title: Capture the supported rendering on Chrome 156 or Firefox
openQuestions.detail: On a build with SVGTextPathSideAttribute (or Firefox), verify the toggle flips the caption inside the ring, that the rendering probe reports a large delta, and that the glyph-box-centre distance drops below the ring radius. The demo asserts and displays all three; they just need a supporting engine to run against.

summary: Canonical inside/outside badge for textPath side: real attribute toggling, live markup, and rendering-based measurement (glyph-box centre vs ring radius) as the honest probe for an attribute with no IDL reflection. Chromium 141 evidence shows the unsupported state reported truthfully everywhere; the flip itself awaits a 156/Firefox verification pass.
